question: What is the meaning of upgrades and repair in relation to durability and extended lifetime?
description: The ability to upgrade a product refers to its capacity to be enhanced or improved to extend its useful life or functionality. On the other hand, repairability pertains to the ease with which a product can be fixed or restored when it malfunctions or breaks down. Both upgrades and repair play crucial roles in ensuring the durability and extended lifetime of a product by allowing for adjustments, improvements, and maintenance to be carried out to keep the product functional and relevant over time.
